_comment: Where each Parakeet ONNX weight file lives in a model repo. THE single source of truth for the layout rule: read by app/src/modelLayout.js (browser + node scripts), scripts/wer-quants.py, and the model repo's wer-fleurs-validation.sh. quantDirs is matched longest-suffix-first against the graph name (sidecar suffix stripped by sidecarPattern); fp32Graphs are matched exactly; anything else lives at the root. fallbackDirs are tried after the layout dir, for the two legacy layouts (flat root, flat plus sharded/). Written with Claude Code.
